title: Degree bound for finite sums
statement: Let $n$ and $r$ be nonnegative integers, let $s$ be a finite set of indices, and let $g_i$ be a function from the $n$-dimensional binary cube to the two-element field for each index $i$. If every $g_i$ with $i\in s$ has algebraic degree at most $r$, then the pointwise sum of the functions indexed by $s$, with values in the two-element field, has algebraic degree at most $r$.
hypotheses_covered: Family of functions from the $n$-dimensional binary cube to the two-element field
Each function indexed by $s$ has algebraic degree at most $r$
